projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
An end-to-end analytics dashboard platform that ingests and processes customer CSV files, analyzes application log data, and surfaces insights through reusable visualization components. Structured as four milestones: Foundation & Architecture, Customer Data Ingestion, Application Log Analysis, and Visualization & Dashboard Delivery.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: MILESTONE — tracking container only; all execution work is delegated to its four child tasks (each complexity 3–4), so this task is never worked directly. Scope: repository and CI tooling, the shared data model and schema contracts, the deployable service skeleton, and a timeboxed storage-layer decision spike.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: MILESTONE — tracking container only; execution happens across six child tasks, each complexity 3–4. Scope: file-level upload validation, header schema detection and mapping, row-level validation with a customer-downloadable error report, normalization into the canonical schema, idempotent upsert loading, and an end-to-end regression corpus. Gated on M1's frozen data model.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: MILESTONE — tracking container only; execution happens across six child tasks, each complexity 3–4. Scope: log event schema and severity taxonomy, the primary JSON-lines parser, a legacy plain-text fallback parser with dead-lettering, hourly/daily rollup jobs for error rate and latency percentiles, scheduled incremental ingestion, and a bounded historical backfill with reconciliation. Gated on M1's frozen data model.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization Components & Dashboard Delivery
tasks.details: MILESTONE — tracking container only; execution happens across four leaf tasks plus three chart components, all complexity 2–4. Scope: design tokens and theming, three separable chart primitives, the metrics query API, the app shell with a URL-driven date filter, the customer and application-health views, the CSV upload screen, and the performance, accessibility, and release-readiness passes.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI pipeline, and local dev tooling
tasks.details: Create the monorepo layout (packages: ingest, logs, api, web), configure linting/formatting/type checking, add a CI workflow that runs tests and builds on every PR, and document the one-command local bootstrap. Done when a fresh clone can install, lint, and run the empty test suites green.

tasks.name: Define analytics data model and shared schema contracts
tasks.details: Write the canonical entity definitions (customer, subscription/account, event/metric fact tables, log event) as versioned schemas in one shared package. Specify naming conventions, time-zone and units rules, and how schema versions are negotiated. This is the contract M2 and M3 must code against, so freeze v1 before downstream work starts.

tasks.name: Scaffold service skeleton, config, and secrets handling
tasks.details: Stand up the API service skeleton (health endpoint, structured logging, error middleware), environment config loading per environment, and secrets storage convention. No business logic — just a deployable shell that ingest, logs, and web can hang off of.

tasks.name: Spike: choose storage and query layer for analytics workloads
tasks.details: Timeboxed two-day spike comparing a columnar warehouse option against the existing relational database for our expected data volume and query shapes. Deliver a one-page recommendation with cost, query latency from a synthetic 1M-row benchmark, and operational burden. Ends with a decision recorded, not a production build.

tasks.name: Build CSV upload endpoint with file-level validation
tasks.details: Implement the upload endpoint: accept multipart CSV, enforce size limit, extension/MIME check, UTF-8 encoding and header presence, and reject duplicates of an identical file hash. Store the raw original for replay, return an upload ID, and emit a job record. Does not parse rows — that is the next task.

tasks.name: Implement customer CSV schema detection and column mapping
tasks.details: Given a header row, match columns to canonical customer fields using exact names, aliases, and case/whitespace normalization. Persist the detected mapping per customer so repeat uploads skip detection, and flag unmapped required fields for manual mapping. Includes a small alias dictionary plus tests for fuzzy header variants.

tasks.name: Write row-level validation rules and downloadable error report
tasks.details: Define the rule set (required fields, type/date/number parsing, enum domains, max lengths, duplicate key detection) and implement per-row evaluation with row numbers. Quarantine invalid rows, apply a configurable fail-fast vs. continue threshold, and produce a CSV error report customers can download listing row, column, and reason.

tasks.name: Define log event schema, severity taxonomy, and parsing rules
tasks.details: Specify the structured log event (timestamp source, service, host, level, message, request/trace IDs, latency, status, free-form attributes) and map the existing ad-hoc severity strings onto one canonical enum. Document which fields are required vs. best-effort and how unknown fields are preserved. Output is a schema plus a written parsing spec.

tasks.name: Implement parser for the primary application log format
tasks.details: Build a streaming parser for the main JSON-lines log format that handles multi-line stack traces and produces canonical log events. Must survive a single corrupt record without aborting the batch, and must track counts of parsed vs. skipped lines. Shim the interface so a second format can be plugged in later.

tasks.name: Add parser fallback for legacy plain-text log lines
tasks.details: Ship a second parser adapter for the legacy space-delimited log lines still emitted by older services, selectable by detection heuristic per file. Unparseable lines go to a dead-letter store with the raw text so nothing is silently lost, and the batch summary reports coverage percentage per format.

tasks.name: Transform and normalize valid rows into the analytics schema
tasks.details: Map validated rows through the column mapping into canonical customer records: coerce dates to UTC, normalize currency and country codes, trim/decollate strings, derive keys, and attach lineage (upload ID, source file, row number). Written as a pure function over a row batch so it is unit-testable without a database.

tasks.name: Implement idempotent load and re-upload dedupe
tasks.details: Load transformed records into the analytics store with upsert semantics keyed on the natural customer key. Re-uploading the same file must produce zero net changes; a corrected file must update changed fields without duplicating rows. Includes transaction/batch-size handling and a load summary (inserted/updated/unchanged).

tasks.name: Build aggregation jobs for error rate, latency percentiles, and traffic
tasks.details: Produce hourly and daily rollups from parsed log events: request counts, error/warn ratios by severity, p50/p95/p99 latency, and top error signatures. Each rollup is recomputable for a single time bucket so late data can be corrected. Persist to the metrics tables defined in the data model.

tasks.name: Schedule log ingestion with incremental watermarks
tasks.details: Run the parser on a schedule against the log source, tracking a per-source watermark so each file segment is processed once, with retry and simple alerting on consecutive failures. Keep the job small and observable: structured run logs plus a last-success timestamp exposed for monitoring.

tasks.name: Establish design tokens and chart theming foundation
tasks.details: Define the visual vocabulary every chart will share: color palette with categorical and sequential scales that pass contrast requirements, typography scale, spacing, and number/date formatters. Ship as framework-agnostic tokens consumed by the component package, with a small storybook-style gallery page.

tasks.name: Build dashboard metrics query/API layer
tasks.details: Expose read-only endpoints that the dashboard calls: time series for a metric + date range + granularity, KPI summaries, and top-N breakdowns. Enforce parameter validation, cap the maximum date range and series count, set response caching headers, and return a stable response envelope that the chart components can consume without reshaping.

tasks.name: Add end-to-end CSV regression suite with fixture corpus
tasks.details: Assemble a fixture corpus covering clean files, renamed columns, mixed date formats, bad encoding, missing required fields, duplicate keys, and a large file for throughput. Assert end-to-end outcomes (counts loaded, error report contents, idempotent re-run) and wire it into CI as a required check.

tasks.name: Backfill historical logs and produce a reconciliation report
tasks.details: Run the parser and rollups across a bounded historical window (last 90 days) in chunks, then reconcile: raw line counts vs. parsed events vs. aggregated totals. Report the delta per day and per source so any gap is explained before the dashboard shows history.

tasks.name: Build core chart primitives: time series, bar, and KPI tile
tasks.details: Container for the three chart primitives, split into separate buildable components so no single task carries three charts. Remaining work at this level is only wiring the primitives into the gallery page and confirming they share the same props contract. Execution happens in the three child tasks.

tasks.name: Build dashboard shell: routing, layout, and global date filter
tasks.details: Create the app shell: route structure for the two dashboard views, responsive grid layout, navigation, and a single global date-range/granularity filter held in the URL so views are shareable. Wire skeleton loading and a global error boundary. No charts inside views yet.

tasks.name: Build customer analytics dashboard view
tasks.details: Compose the customer-facing view from the primitives: KPI strip (total customers, new in period, active rate), customer growth time series, segment breakdown bar chart, and a sortable top-customers table. Uses the global date filter, shows data freshness, and includes a view-level integration test against mocked API responses.

tasks.name: Build application health (log analysis) dashboard view
tasks.details: Compose the operational view: error-rate time series with severity split, p50/p95/p99 latency chart, request-volume chart, and a top error signatures list linking to the raw log slice. Reuses the same global filter and primitives; includes a view-level integration test and an empty-state for periods with no logs.

tasks.name: Build CSV upload screen with error-report download
tasks.details: UI for the ingestion flow: drag-and-drop upload with progress, per-upload status list (queued, validating, loaded, failed), validation summary counts, and a download link for the rejected-rows report. Shows schema-mapping prompts when required columns are unmatched. Small, self-contained, and tested against mocked endpoints.

tasks.name: Set performance budget and run optimization pass
tasks.details: Define budgets (dashboard LCP under 2.5s on a mid-range laptop, API p95 under 800ms for a 90-day single-series query, JS payload under 250KB gzipped) and measure them. Then make targeted fixes: query caching, downsampling large series, code-splitting chart bundles. Report before/after numbers against the budget.

tasks.name: Run accessibility audit and fix findings
tasks.details: Audit all screens and chart primitives for keyboard reachability, focus order, contrast, screen-reader labeling of data series, and non-color-only encoding of severity. Provide a data-table fallback for each chart. Fix all critical/serious findings and record remaining advisory items with owners.

tasks.name: Ship release checklist, runbook, and stakeholder demo
tasks.details: Assemble the go-live package: deployment steps and rollback, data-refresh monitoring checks, known limitations, and on-call ownership for ingest and log jobs. Record a 15-minute demo walkthrough of both dashboards against real data, and capture sign-off from the requesting stakeholders.

tasks.name: Implement time-series line/area chart component
tasks.details: Single chart only: time-series line/area renderer with tooltip, legend, and configurable granularity. Accepts the API envelope directly; renders empty, loading, and error states. Ships with component tests covering data shape edge cases (single point, gaps, nulls).

tasks.name: Implement categorical bar chart component
tasks.details: Single chart only: categorical bar chart (vertical/horizontal, grouped or single series) with value labels and tooltip, using the categorical palette. Handles long labels via truncation and overflow scroll, plus empty/loading/error states and component tests.

tasks.name: Implement KPI tile with trend delta component
tasks.details: Single component only: KPI tile showing headline value, comparison-period delta with direction indicator, and optional sparkline slot. Formats numbers/dates through the shared formatters and exposes loading/error states. Component tests for formatting and delta edge cases (zero baseline).
